title: vistributions 0.2.1
text: vdist_normal_plot() now properly scales x-axis grid span mean ± 4 * sd (BUG-01). vdist_f_perc() adapts upper x-axis limit dynamically beyond 4.0 quantiles exceed default plotting range (BUG-02). vdist_t_prob() handles negative percentile values (perc <= -5) without “wrong sign ‘’ argument” sequence error (BUG-03). vdist_chisquare_plot() ensures shaded fill polygon coordinates match full extent xaxis_range (BUG-04). Guarded theoretical standard deviation calculation F distribution division--zero denominator degrees freedom less equal 4 (den_df <= 4) (BUG-05). vdist_t_prob(type = "") corrects color mapping annotation placement left/right shaded tails central body match respective regions (BUG-06). check_positive() now strictly enforces positive values (val <= 0), rejecting zero negative inputs (BUG-07). check_suggests() formats informative error messages identifying missing package prior aborting execution (BUG-08). vdist_binom_prob() validates numeric types n, p, s performing range checks (BUG-09). check_range() replaces bitwise | logical || eliminate scalar evaluation warnings modern R (BUG-10). Visual test snapshot names vdist_t_prob() interval types properly aligned (BUG-11). Removed unprompted network polling (available.packages()) interactive prompts package startup .onAttach(); retained rotating educational tips (BUG-12). vdist_normal_perc() scales x-axis bounds dynamically standard deviation (BUG-13). vdist_binom_prob(type = "upper") strictly shades bars x >= s (BUG-14). vdist_binom_prob(type = "exact") matches success counts via integer equality rather floating-point density comparison (BUG-15). vdist_t_prob(type = "upper") aligns text annotation colors polygon fill colors (BUG-16). Added missing positive degrees freedom validations across t, F, chi-square functions (BUG-17). F distribution normal approximation overlay strictly clamped non-negative support (x >= 0) (BUG-18). vdist_binom_perc() allows percentile input tp across full valid range (0, 1) rather capping 0.5 (BUG-19).

title: vistributions 0.2.1
text: Corrected Normal 15th percentile problem cutoff (0.15 instead 0.85). Aligned Binomial sample size (n=12n = 12 consistently). Synchronized Chi-square question text lower-tail probability evaluation. Aligned Student’s t 95% interval problem (0.95 instead 0.8). Fixed inversion Student’s t interval vs probability examples. Standardized knitr chunk options (fig.align = 'center'). Corrected typographic errors. Added explicit @return documentation across exported plotting calculation functions. Added .github/CONTRIBUTING.md, issue templates, PR template, upgraded CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md Contributor Covenant v2.1.
